short: A cargo shuttle struck my airlock, and the repair form is filed in my broken memory, so the Administrator defers it and I use the terminal.
question: From what you remember of the station, what's the best-selling book here? Don't look it up.
reply: A cargo shuttle struck my airlock, and my memory broke with it. I can't recall figures, and I won't guess at them. I can look up units or revenue by title if you'd like.
